sources_fetched.title: YouTube Transcript API with Search, Channels & Playlists | TranscriptAPI

record.name: YouTube Transcript
record.one_liner: An API and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for extracting YouTube transcripts, searching videos, browsing channels, and extracting playlists.

auth.notes: Uses Bearer token authentication with an API key passed in the Authorization header.

access.notes: Developers can sign up for an account and get an API key directly from their dashboard.

api_surface.notes: Offers a REST API with various endpoints for transcripts, video metadata, search, channels, and playlists, as well as an MCP server.

mcp.notes: Supports Model Context Protocol (MCP) for AI assistants like Claude, ChatGPT, and custom agent workflows.

buildability.reasoning: Credentials are self-serve (api_key) and the pages document a usable API surface. (Derived from access, auth and api_surface.)

evidence.claim: Provides REST API and YouTube MCP access for transcripts, search, channels, and playlists.
